Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. e supplier's bill as Performance Security and released after completion of the warranty period. Alternatively, the supplier may submit a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) for an equivalent amount in lieu of the retention. 6. Payment terms: 70% of the order value, along with 100% of the applicable taxes, payable 45 days on credit. 20% Payment: Upon successful erection and commissioning of the machine or 120 days from Supply whic h ever earlier. 10% Payment: Upon submission of a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) after successful erection and com missioning. 8. In event of supplier default, AYCL reserves right for cancellation and risk purchase at supplier's risk an d cost after due notice. 14. ePBG /Bid Security (to be submitted within 14 days of PO) – total 5% of PO Basic Value . 15.
